content:
samir: Heads-up — long-tail RI expirations clustered next quarter for eu-west-1 GPU pools, need a mitigation plan.
elaine: Which families/regions exactly? quick numbers pls.
miguel: echoing, curious how spread they are across prod vs dedicated.
samir: Mostly p4d and g5. Quick billing pull shows ~18 p4d and ~40 g5 reserved across a mix of accounts (prod + dedicated).
finance-leah: FYI utilization for those reservations is uneven — a lot of tail idle time last 30d. :thinking_face:
ops-bot: Billing alert: RI amortization drop scheduled for 2024-06-14 for account-redwood-eu.
elaine: Ok. Options: (a) replace with new 1yr RIs (b) convert to convertible RIs (c) use short flexible commitments where possible (d) shift workloads to spot/ondemand temporarily.
samir: I want a pro-rata plan to smooth monthly spend instead of one big renewal hit. Miguel — can you propose tranche sizes?
miguel: Proposal: 3-wave approach. Buy 25% now focused on high-utilized pools, 50% in ~6 weeks (after demand stabilizes), 25% in final month before majority expire. Spreads capex and reduces risk.
finance-leah: ran a quick delta: if we do nothing cost delta ~ $32k/mo vs current amortized baseline. With 40% workload shift to spot in parallel we can shave ~ $12k/mo.
elaine: Also consider convertible RIs for the p4d set to retain flexibility across instance families. Conversion penalties look minimal vs potential lock-in.
samir: Can someone run a utilization query so we have hard numbers?
samir: ```aws ce get-reservation-utilization --time-period Start=2024-03-01,End=2024-04-01 --granularity MONTHLY```
miguel: quick sample from that run:
samir: ```ReservedHours: 4320
UsedHours: 2650
Utilization: 61%```
finance-leah: So ~39% of hours unused. If we trim or reallocate those, we can avoid buying full replacement capacity.
elaine: Actionable asks: 1) per-account RI breakdown with tags 2) hot-pool list (currently >80% utilization) 3) cost model for 3-wave buys + spot shift scenario.
samir: I'll pull per-account breakdown by tag and post CSV here within the hour.
miguel: I can model the 3-wave purchases and run sensitivity for utilization +/-10%.
finance-leah: I'll update the cost sheet and show month-by-month cashflow. Also prep a 12-month vs 3-year comparison for exec.
elaine: Add tagging rules so newly idle GPUs are flagged for rehoming. Also add an alert to pause tranche 2 if utilization drops below threshold.
miguel: Suggested guardrail: if overall RI utilization <50% after tranche 1, hold tranche 2 and re-evaluate.
ops-bot: Reminder created: "RI purchase tranche 2 review" assigned to @elaine in 6 weeks.
samir: Attached CSV + per-account rows (uploaded to #eng-infra, link: https://files.redwood/infradata/ri_breakdown_q2.csv)
finance-leah: From CSV — 3 accounts have large orphaned reservations (tags missing). I'll coordinate cleanup before tranche 2.
elaine: Good. Next check-in: tranche 1 execution window tomorrow noon. Miguel, Samir, Leah — can you confirm by EOD?
miguel: Confirmed.
samir: Confirmed, will run final spot shift schedule.
finance-leah: Confirmed, will sign off the purchase plan.
elaine: Thanks. We'll reconvene after tranche 1 to validate numbers. :thumbsup:
